speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to begin my assessment, how long have you been experiencing these breathing difficulties, and were you born prematurely?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity. The combination of birth at 32 weeks and cesarean delivery (which reduces lung fluid clearance) strongly points to surfactant deficiency, especially given the maternal history of gestational diabetes which can delay labor initiation. I will now request a Chest_X-Ray to confirm the characteristic ground-glass appearance.
